- "chassisandvehicle"

The "powerbattery" table contains information about the power battery, including cycles, current, voltage, level percent, temperature, and health percent.

The "engineandfluids" table contains information about the engine and fluids, including oil, fuel, coolant, and hydraulic data such as pressure, level percent, temperature, and consumption.

The "waterandwaste" table contains information about water and waste, including water data such as level percent, pressure, temperature, and flow, as well as waste data such as tank level percent and temperature.

The "scientific" table contains information about scientific equipment, including equipment status, data logging status, sensor status, calibration status, and measurement accuracy percent.

The "transmission" table contains information about the transmission, including transmission data such as temperature, pressure, and gear, as well as differential and axle data such as temperature.

The "chassisandvehicle" table contains information about the chassis and vehicle, including brake data such as pad wear percent, fluid level percent, and pressure, as well as track data such as tension and wear percent, suspension height, vehicle speed, load, angle, and heading, and tire metrics.
